mainEntity.name: How often should I do this facial?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most patients benefit from this facial every 4 to 6 weeks as part of monthly skin maintenance. The cadence respects the natural skin renewal cycle. We may recommend a more spaced schedule for sensitive skin or a tighter cadence for acne-prone skin in active phases.

mainEntity.name: Is it safe before an event?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. The Deep Cleanse + Glow Facial is non-aggressive and most patients leave with skin that is calmer and more luminous within hours. We recommend scheduling it 2–4 days before a major event to give the skin its full window to settle and reveal the glow.

Not as a rule. Mild post-extraction redness is normal for a few hours. If the skin has significant active congestion before the session, a few small breakouts may surface in the following days as the pore content clears. We provide aftercare guidance to support the skin through the recovery.

hero.title: Deep Cleanse + Glow Facial in Miami
hero.lede: A clinical deep cleanse facial that combines gentle exfoliation, careful manual extractions and a hydration finish to reset the skin, decongest pores and restore healthy glow.

blocks.title: What it does for you
list: Decongests clogged pores through careful manual extractions.
Removes dead-cell build-up with a clinical-grade gentle exfoliation.
Restores hydration and radiance through a tailored mask and serum sequence.
Ideal as monthly maintenance or as preparation before a procedure or event.
60-minute experience designed for an efficient appointment.
Skin is left visibly cleaner, calmer and more luminous the same day.
